# `revision.create`

<!-- Generated by `cargo xtask docs-gen` from crates/ew-commands/schemas/revision.create.schema.json. Do not edit: change the source and regenerate. -->

`revision.create` (`CreateRevision`): a project revision (doc 03 §18, FR-REV-001, FT-165): the open
revision that collects the current edits, or a historic released revision (released before the project
came to ElektraWatt: no release record, no as-built archive).

Creates `Revision {label, date, author, checker, description, state, page_notes}` with a new ID; author
and checker are party roles (FR-PRJ-003). Rejected: a label that another revision has, other than a
withdrawal record (EW-INV-017); state `open` while another revision is open (EW-INV-016); a checker
equal to the author (at `/checker`, EW-INV-018); a page note on a page that does not exist (at
`/page_notes/<i>/page`) or a second note on one page (at `/page_notes/<i>`, EW-INV-019). The label's
format and order (FR-REV-002) are the release-gate and prevent rule EW-REL-004's, not this command's.
The command never changes an existing revision. Outcome: the revision.

## Parameters

| Name | Type | Required | Default | Description |
|---|---|---|---|---|
| `author` | [`PartyRole`](#partyrole) or `null` | no |  | The author, as a party role. |
| `checker` | [`PartyRole`](#partyrole) or `null` | no |  | The checker, as a party role; never the author's. |
| `date` | [`Date`](#date) or `null` | no |  | The revision date. |
| `description` | [`CmdMlText`](#cmdmltext) | no |  | What the revision changes. |
| `label` | [`CmdIdent`](#cmdident) | yes |  | The label in the project's one format ("V2.0"). |
| `page_notes` | array of [`RevisionPageNote`](#revisionpagenote) | no |  | The pages the revision declares as changed, at most one note per page. |
| `state` | [`NewRevisionState`](#newrevisionstate) | no | `"open"` | `open` (the default) or `released` (historic). |

## Types

### CmdIdent

An identifier: non-empty, one line, NFC, without leading or trailing white space (doc 05 §3.2).

Type: string (at least 1 character(s))

Pattern: `^[^\u0000-\u0020\u007F-\u00A0\u1680\u2000-\u200A\u2028\u2029\u202F\u205F\u3000](?:[^\u0000-\u001F\u007F-\u009F]*[^\u0000-\u0020\u007F-\u00A0\u1680\u2000-\u200A\u2028\u2029\u202F\u205F\u3000])?$`

### CmdMlText

Multilingual text: a neutral string, or an object keyed by canonical BCP 47 tags in ascending order with non-empty string values (doc 05 §3.2).

One of the following forms:

1. **Form 1**

   Shape: string

2. **Form 2**

   Shape: map of string (at least 1 character(s)) (at least 1 propert(ies))

### Date

An authored date YYYY-MM-DD (doc 05 §3.2).

Type: string (pattern `^[0-9]{4}-[0-9]{2}-[0-9]{2}$`)

Pattern: `^[0-9]{4}-[0-9]{2}-[0-9]{2}$`

### NewRevisionState

The state of a new revision.

| Value | Meaning |
|---|---|
| `"open"` | The revision that collects the current edits (at most one, EW-INV-016). |
| `"released"` | A historic released revision: released before the project came to ElektraWatt, so it has no release record and no as-built archive (Golden A's V1.0). |

### PartyRole

The role of a `Party`.

| Value | Meaning |
|---|---|
| `"customer"` | Customer. |
| `"end_user"` | End user. |
| `"panel_builder"` | Panel builder (legal owner of the drawings). |
| `"author"` | Author. |
| `"checker"` | Checker. |
| `"engineer"` | Engineer. |

### RevisionPageNote

One page a new revision declares as changed (FR-REV-012).

| Name | Type | Required | Default | Description |
|---|---|---|---|---|
| `description` | [`CmdMlText`](#cmdmltext) | no |  | What changed on the page. |
| `page` | [`CmdUuid`](#cmduuid) | yes |  | The page. |

### CmdUuid

A lower-case hyphenated UUID naming a record (doc 05 §3.2).

Type: string (at least 36 character(s), at most 36 character(s))

Pattern: `^[0-9a-f]{8}-[0-9a-f]{4}-[0-9a-f]{4}-[0-9a-f]{4}-[0-9a-f]{12}$`

## Exit codes

A command runs as one line of a command log replayed by `ew apply` ([doc 17 §3.5](https://github.com/Ironkode787/ElektraWatt/blob/main/docs/design/17-extensibility.md#35-command-logs-ewcmd)). The exit code of `ew apply` is:

| Code | Meaning |
|---|---|
| 0 | The line committed as one transaction. |
| 1 | A prevent rule or the command's own domain rule refused the line (`Prevented`, `Rejected`); without `--one-step` the lines before it stay committed and are saved, with `--one-step` nothing is saved. |
| 2 | Anything else stops the replay: invalid parameters, a missing record, an unresolvable reference, an open, lock or save error. |

The codes of every subcommand are in [doc 17 §3.2](https://github.com/Ironkode787/ElektraWatt/blob/main/docs/design/17-extensibility.md#32-exit-codes).
